narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On August 21, 2024, at approximately 1440 hours, Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered the subject at a factory in Lansing, Michigan, during a follow-up on a referral from ICE. The subject stated that he is a citizen of India and presented an Indian passport.
IMMIGRATION HISTORY:
05/12/2009 - admitted at Detroit Metropolitan Airport as a B2 visitor.
11/12/2009 - authorized stay expired.
03/04/2016 - encountered by ICE in Lansing, Michigan; released.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is being presented for prosecution under 8 U.S.C. 1326 as an alien found in the United States after removal.
DISPOSITION:
The case was referred to the U.S. Attorney's Office.
